subject: Post-call: budget view & batching levers (pilot qualification)
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Rogers <elliot@clearforge.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up + concise recap from today (budget view & batching levers)

Elliot — thanks again for carving out 30 minutes today. Quick, action-oriented recap from my side so we’re aligned on next steps. I pulled the key points into bullets to keep things scannable.

What we confirmed today:
- Primary goal: reduce token spend for ClearForge’s inference pipelines while maintaining <1s generation p50 on customer-facing flows.
- Pain: current spend trajectory will exceed budget by Q3 if call volumes rise; engineering bandwidth to re-architect is limited.
- Workloads discussed: webhook-triggered agent responses (~60% of calls), async batch reporting (20%), embeddings for search (20%).

Short-term levers we discussed (ordered by expected unit impact):
1) Continuous batching for webhook flows — expected 30–45% token-cost reduction depending on latency SLOs.
2) Prefix/KV caching for repeated prompts (search + context reuse) — 20–40% reduction on repeat-heavy sessions.
3) Model quantization / lower-cost variant for non-sensitive routes — 15–25% tradeoff with small quality delta.

Next steps we agreed on:
- I’ll share a compact token-econ workbook with two scenarios (conservative / aggressive) by EOD today. (attachment: token-econ-scenarios.xlsx)
- Marissa will schedule a 45-minute pilot planning call with your engineering + procurement for Wed/Thu next week.
- Elliot to confirm whether data residency / SOC2 evidence is required for the pilot.

Quick ask: can you confirm the three constraints you mentioned on the call so we use them as gating criteria in the workbook? You listed: monthly budget cap (~$18k), no infra changes from your side for the pilot, and SLO p50 <1s. If any of these changed, please flag.

Thanks again — I’ll attach the scenarios and a short SOW draft in a follow-up.

— Lukas
Lukas Meyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
attachments: token-econ-scenarios.xlsx
From: Elliot Rogers <elliot@clearforge.ai>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@clearforge.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + concise recap from today (budget view & batching levers)

Thanks Lukas — that tracks. Couple clarifications from our side:

- Budget: the $18k/month is the informal target; leadership has pushed to keep pilot spend under $10k/month until we see clear unit savings. So please include a conservative scenario that targets a $6–10k monthly pilot spend.
- Infra: correct, we can’t make infra changes for the initial pilot; we can use an SDK integration or a lightweight proxy.
- SLO: p50 <1s for the webhook happy path is a hard requirement; p95 can be relaxed to ~3s for backfill flows.

On compliance: procurement asked for SOC2 Type II evidence and TRC on data retention — I can share a contact in procurement who’ll own that ask.

Appreciate the quick turnaround on the workbook.

— Elliot
Elliot Rogers
Head of Product, ClearForge AI

Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposed pilot SOW + budget options

Elliot — looping in a short SOW sketch and two pilot options so procurement has something concrete to review. Attached: pilot-sow-draft.pdf + same token workbook (xlsx). High-level options:

Option A — Proof-of-value (low risk)
- Duration: 6 weeks
- Spend cap: $6k/month (Redwood credits available to offset first month)
- Scope: webhook flows only, SDK integration, no infra changes
- Expected outcome: measurable 15–30% token reduction via batching + caching; UX latency p50 target preserved

Option B — Scaled pilot (faster signal)
- Duration: 8 weeks
- Spend cap: $12k/month
- Scope: webhook + async reporting + embeddings sampling; includes quantized model path for non-sensitive routes
- Expected outcome: 30–45% token reduction on targeted routes; stronger confidence interval for ROI

Marissa — small ask for you: which option aligns better with ClearForge’s procurement risk appetite? We can also scope a phased approach (start A -> expand to B after 3 weeks).

Attachments: pilot-sow-draft.pdf, token-econ-scenarios.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll put tentative times for Wed/Thu next week.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — procurement wants Option A with the phased clause (start small, expand if thresholds met). They asked for:
- A one-page security appendix (SOC2 reference + data retention table)
- A short price sheet showing how batching + caching reduces units (happy to use the workbook)

We can do Wed 10am PT for the call — I’ll invite our security lead and procurement contact.

Action items going into the call:
- Redwood: send one-page security appendix + updated workbook showing conservative $6k/month scenario.
- ClearForge: procurement will prepare standard PO terms and a short list of security questions.

See you on Wednesday.

— Elliot
